scope: Actual gate/up weights with natural M256/M512 routing replay; inclusive BF16-to-D8 producer pack plus selected gate/up.
candidate: Have only each adjacent column pair's even lane gather the eight next-K32 raw T16 words, then broadcast them to the odd lane with eight wave shuffles.
command: GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=2 HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q4_k_mmq_leaf_bench.py --rows 256,512 --modes t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf-rawprefetch-p8,t16-mmq128x32-d8-f32-wavecols-direct-doublebuf-rawprefetch-p8-pair-shared --warmups 4 --samples 41 --burst 3 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-q4-raw-prefetch-p8-pair-shared-leaf.json
decision: Reject and remove pair-shared P8. Adjacent lanes' duplicate logical gathers already coalesce; eight wave shuffles add latency without reducing physical transactions.
